app.name: Binance PHP Connector
app.one_liner: A modular, auto-generated PHP SDK providing secure REST API access to Binance's trading and financial services.

screens.name: Connector Dashboard
screens.purpose: Display available Binance service connectors and allow selection for API interaction.

rust_commands.name: configure_authentication
rust_commands.purpose: Set up API credentials and signature method (HMAC, RSA, or Ed25519) for secure API access.

rust_commands.name: instantiate_connector
rust_commands.purpose: Create an instance of a specific Binance service connector (e.g., Spot, Convert, Crypto Loans).

mvp_plan: week 1: Add basic error handling for class loading
acceptance_tests: System handles missing class errors gracefully with clear guidance.
User can configure HMAC authentication using API key and secret without runtime errors.
User can instantiate Spot connector and call a basic endpoint (e.g., /api/v3/ping).
